name: Soltszentimre (Hungary)
description: Pale turquoise field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Soltszentimre: a crowned quartered shield of red, blue, white and green with a tower, a fleur-de-lis and a bunch of grapes, above a scroll inscribed Soltszentimre.
history: The flag of Soltszentimre was adopted on 27 March 2007. Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Soltszentimre arms with crown and scroll
